description: Estimates a valuation range, 0-100 investor score, archetype, and top three improvement priorities for a business from its operating metrics: revenue model, MRR, monthly churn, month-over-month growth, and months live, plus optional active users, CAC, and LTV. For a business the user owns or operates. Deterministic and versioned (unified-v1): identical inputs return identical results. Out-of-range values return an error naming the field.

activeUsers.description: Active users or paying customers, when known.

cac.description: Customer acquisition cost in USD. Used only together with ltv.

churnPercent.description: Monthly customer churn as a percent, e.g. 3 means 3% of customers cancel each month.

growthRatePercent.description: Month-over-month revenue growth as a percent, e.g. 8 means +8% per month. Negative for decline.

ltv.description: Customer lifetime value in USD. Used only together with cac.

monetization.description: Primary revenue model. 'SaaS Subscription' for recurring software; 'Marketplace' for commission/take-rate businesses; 'Advertising' for ad-funded content; 'One-time Purchase' for ecommerce, templates, or lifetime deals; 'Freemium' for free tiers that convert to paid; 'Services' for agencies and productized services.

monthsActive.description: Months the business has been live or earning revenue.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in USD (average monthly revenue for non-subscription models; 0 when pre-revenue).

name: value_business

assumptions.description: Every value EvalyMe assumed, derived, or capped. Empty when all inputs were supplied.

engineVersion.description: Model version; results with the same version and inputs are identical.

impliedMultipleOnArr.description: Range midpoint divided by ARR. Absent when ARR is 0.

investorScore.description: 0-100 operating score from six weighted signals.

modelInput.description: The exact inputs the engine used.

priorities.description: Up to three weakest weighted signals, each with one concrete next step.

saveToEvalyMeUrl.description: Opens this estimate in the EvalyMe app so the user can save, track, and improve it.

title: Value a business
